SELECT tg.goal_id AS goalId, ub.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, 1 AS categoryId, tg.title AS title, DATE_FORMAT(tg.start_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS targetDate, NULL AS detail, CASE WHEN ub.bookmark_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS bookmarked FROM travel_goal tg
LEFT JOIN user_bookmark ub ON ub.user_id = tg.user_id AND ub.category_id = 1 AND ub.goal_id = tg.goal_id AND ub.del_yn = 'N'
WHERE tg.user_id = #{userId} AND tg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND tg.del_yn = 'N' AND (#{category} = 'all' OR #{category} = 'travel')
UNION ALL
SELECT jg.goal_id AS goalId, ub.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, 2 AS categoryId,
CASE WHEN jg.goal_type IN ('J01', 'J02') THEN jc2.category_name
WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J03' THEN CONCAT( REPLACE(jtu.univ_name, '대학교', '대'), ' · ', jtmc.major_name )
ELSE '진로 목표' END AS title,
REPLACE(jg.expected_date, '-', '.') AS targetDate,
CASE WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J01' THEN '취업'
WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J02' THEN jc1.category_name
WHEN jg.goal_type = 'J03' THEN '편입'
ELSE NULL END AS detail,
CASE WHEN ub.bookmark_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS bookmarked
FROM job_goal jg
LEFT JOIN job_category jc2 ON jg.category_id = jc2.category_id AND jc2.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_category jc1 ON jc2.parent_id = jc1.category_id AND jc1.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_university jtu ON jg.univ_id = jtu.univ_id AND jtu.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_major jtm ON jg.major_id = jtm.major_id AND jtm.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN job_transfer_major_category jtmc ON jtm.major_code = jtmc.major_code AND jtmc.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN user_bookmark ub ON ub.user_id = jg.user_id AND ub.category_id = 2 AND ub.goal_id = jg.goal_id AND ub.del_yn = 'N'
WHERE jg.user_id = #{userId} AND jg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND jg.del_yn = 'N' AND (#{category} = 'all' OR #{category} = 'job')
UNION ALL
SELECT cg.goal_id AS goalId, ub.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, 3 AS categoryId,
COALESCE( CONCAT( cm.model_name, CASE WHEN cg.selected_year IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (', cg.selected_year, ')') ELSE '' END ), '자동차 구매 목표' ) AS title,
DATE_FORMAT(cg.target_date, '%Y.%m.%d') AS targetDate, NULL AS detail,
CASE WHEN ub.bookmark_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS bookmarked
FROM car_goal cg
LEFT JOIN car_model cm ON cg.selected_model_id = cm.model_id AND cm.del_yn = 'N'
LEFT JOIN user_bookmark ub ON ub.user_id = cg.user_id AND ub.category_id = 3 AND ub.goal_id = cg.goal_id AND ub.del_yn = 'N'
WHERE cg.user_id = #{userId} AND cg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND cg.del_yn = 'N' AND (#{category} = 'all' OR #{category} = 'car')
UNION ALL
SELECT rg.goal_id AS goalId, ub.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, 4 AS categoryId, COALESCE(rg.title, '자취 목표') AS title, NULL AS targetDate, CONCAT(rg.residence_months, '개월 거주') AS detail,
CASE WHEN ub.bookmark_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS bookmarked
FROM rent_goal rg
LEFT JOIN user_bookmark ub ON ub.user_id = rg.user_id AND ub.category_id = 4 AND ub.goal_id = rg.goal_id AND ub.del_yn = 'N'
WHERE rg.user_id = #{userId} AND rg.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND rg.del_yn = 'N' AND (#{category} = 'all' OR #{category} = 'rent')
ORDER BY targetDate DESC
